Question: What made you happy today?
Answer: I went to District Court today. This was my first visit to court as a Law student. I was very excited to go inside. There was this huge building of 9 floors. It was full of people. Everyone rushing here and there. All the lawyers with damn personality with the interns following them. It's like a dream for every law student to be at that spot, where you are walking ahead and few people are following you. It's surreal feeling man. Very serious vibes you get everywhere. People walking around with files and documents. Lawyers and their associates discussing the matter. The witnesses giving their presence. But I must say the court rooms we see in movies are much different in reality. I just somehow managed to creep into the court room and get a click. I was afraid while clicking the picture. I didn't get to see the proceedings :(. But I went inside the court room where no proceedings were going on. Entering court room in itself was a tense feeling. As soon as I entered the court room, a sense of nervousness started creeping me as if I was going to be a part of proceeding to be conducted there at. Meanwhile managed to get a click of this beautiful cable stayed bridge from the window of a court room. Yes that's my city. City of bridges 🌉. Question: What are some of the wildest things you’ve done in school?
Answer: This is the incident when I was in 11th grade. So, once during our Chemistry class, sir told us that Sodium (Na) reacts very violently with water. It causes explosion and also blasting sound. I was very fascinated by this fact. Mere dimaag mai ek khurafaati idea aaya 😂. ( I thought of a mischievous idea ) After 2 days, we had our practicals in the chemistry lab. So, I thought I will just secretly take the Sodium from the cupboard. But, Sodium being highly reactive was kept at a safer place in the storage cupboard which used to remain locked. Now, I wanted Sodium at any cost. I purposefully emptied one bottle of a chemical I guess it was some form of Mangnese. So, I threw the chemical in the sink and asked the lab assistant to fill it. He then opened the cupboard, I was standing behind and my eyes were constantly searching for Sodium. After peeking here and there, ahh I saw Sodium which was kept in a dark bottle with some liquid, I guess it was kerosene. I distracted the lab assistant telling him that chemistry sir is calling you and then he left. Meanwhile, I quickly took the Sodium bottle and hid it somehow in my pocket. After the practical got over, it was time for a break. So, I decided to blast some explosives in washroom 😂. I was never this courageous but you know that curiosity, led me do that. I went inside the washroom and made sure no one is inside and slowly durr se ek dum, threw the piece of Sodium into the bucket of water. Now, as soon as the Sodium chunk came into contact of water, it started bouncing on the surface and flames were produced. I was watching all of this happening from a distance. Then I heard a boom sound and without even thinking for a second, I frighteningly ran from there. Haaesh. Everyone gathered around the washroom as to see what happened ? But no one could find out the reason. I was just laughing and smiling and looking at everyone. That's what you call a daring task. I am still smiling while writing about this. Naughty me 🙈. Also, I hated physics. Adding to my hatred Physics was our first lecture in the morning. So, what I would do was at the end of the day, while going home, once in a while, I removed air from the tyre of physics’ teachers bike 🙈😂. He used to reach his home safely and in morning he used to realize that tyre is flattened. This made him late many atimes and physics lecture - proxy. Maza aata tha 🤫😂. Until we meet again, Rabiya 💕

Question: Have you ever experienced a random act of kindness towards you from a stranger?
Answer: “No dad, I want it. Please this one is last. I promise” I said it loud standing outside a toy shop like any other stubborn kid would do. Back in 2011 - I and my family, we were roaming onto the streets of a ‘Jeddah' - a city in saudi arabia. I was 11 years old back then and I saw a huge toy shop nearby. Knowing no limits to my excitement, I ran into that shop and picked up 2 kitchen sets and 2–3 other toys. My dad was just looking at me while I was selecting all the toys. He was standing there and walking around with me. When I was done, looking at all the toys, I ran to the billing counter. Just the uncle was about to bill the items, I picked up, dad interrupted in between and asked me to pick up just one out of the two kitchen sets I chose. Both the kitchen sets were too cute and I didn't want to give up on any of it. My dad using his all time tactic told - ‘Rabiya, either select any one of the kitchen set or else I am not getting you anything’. Saying this to me, dad went and stood at the exit of the store. “No dad, I want it. Please this one is last. I promise” I said it loud standing outside a toy shop like any other stubborn kid would do. I thought time to use - crying technique, XD. I am stubborn and so is my dad. Sigh. I started crying and was requesting my dad to get me all the toys. ‘Tell me, which toy you want to buy' - I heard a uncle saying. ‘I will get it for you' he added. ‘Uncle, see my dad is asking me to choose between these two kitchen sets but I want both’, I said while making a cute crying face. ‘Okay, so the other kitchen set is on me. Come show, which one you want' said the stranger uncle. ‘No,no. Thank you. The thing is she already has too many kitchen sets at home and that's the reason I am reluctant to buy her two of it but anyway she is so stubborn, I will get her both of it. You please don't worry' - said my Dad while stopping that uncle. ‘ No brother, you know I am from Pakistan. I have a daughter. She is almost similar to your daughter. I am missing her so much today. Please let me buy your daughter this toy, it will make me happy’ - said that stranger uncle. So, he bought me that kitchen set and my dad bought me other toys. He was so generous, he just saw me crying from distance and gave me that toy as a gift. That was so kind of him. I still have that kitchen set. I don't play with it anymore. My niece and nephew, they play with it now. I clearly remember every detail about this incident. While writing this, I lived that moment again. Ahh.. a trip down to the memory lane. Some people they leave a significant imprint on your life no matter how small. Rabiya
